name: imma_sp16864
desc: IMMA.SP.16864 int8 2:4-structured-sparse tensor-core MMA (CUTLASS sparse tensorop GEMM class, 15_ampere_sparse_tensorop_gemm). One warp computes the m16n8k64 sparse atom D = C + A_dense(16x64,s8)*B(8x64,s8)^T, where A is given COMPRESSED (16x32 kept) plus metadata E selecting which 2 of every 4 K-cols per group are non-zero (cutlass host_uncompress.h 2:4 rule). Warp-true fragment gather + per-lane metadata decode; compared to a host integer-GEMM oracle (exact, no rounding).
